0x0444C35.en: This is a newly discovered Pokémon. It is\pcurrently under investigation. No detailed\pinformation is available at this time.

0x0444CB2.en: It carries a seed on its back right from\pbirth. As it grows older, the seed also\pgrows larger.

0x0444D12.en: If the bud on its back starts to smell\psweet, it is evidence that the large\pflower will soon bloom.

0x0444D77.en: By spreading the broad petals of its\pflower and catching the sun’s rays, it\pfills its body with power.

0x0444DDF.en: The flame on its tail shows the strength\pof its life force. If it is weak, the\pflame also burns weakly.

0x0444E48.en: It is very hot-headed by nature, so it\pconstantly seeks opponents. It calms\pdown only when it wins.

0x0444EAD.en: Breathing intense, hot flames, it can\pmelt almost anything. Its breath inflicts\pterrible pain on enemies.

0x0444F18.en: The shell, which hardens soon after\pit is born, is resilient. If you poke it,\pit will bounce back out.

0x0444F80.en: This Pokémon is very popular among\polder people as its fur-covered tail is\pa symbol of its longevity.

0x0444FE7.en: The rocket cannons on its shell fire\pjets of water capable of punching holes\pthrough thick steel.

0x044504A.en: Its feet have suction cups designed\pto stick to any surface. It tenaciously\pclimbs trees to forage.

0x04450AF.en: It prepares for evolution by hardening\pits shell as much as possible to protect\pits soft body.

0x044510F.en: Water-repellent powder on its wings\penables it to collect honey, even in\pthe heaviest of rains.

0x0445170.en: Its poison stinger is very powerful.\pIts bright-colored body is intended\pto warn off its enemies.

0x04451D3.en: Although it is a cocoon, it can move\pa little. It can extend its poison barb\pif it is attacked.

0x0445234.en: It can take down any opponent with\pits powerful poison stingers.\pIt sometimes attacks in swarms.

0x0445296.en: Common in grassy areas and forests,\pit is very docile and will chase off\penemies by flapping up sand.

0x04452FD.en: It flies over its wide territory in\psearch of prey, downing it with its\phighly developed claws.

0x044535E.en: By flapping its wings with all its might,\pPidgeot can make a gust of wind\pcapable of bending tall trees.

0x04453C8.en: Living wherever there is food available,\pit ceaselessly scavenges for edibles\pthe entire day.

0x0445427.en: Its rear feet have three toes each.\pThey are webbed, enabling it to swim\pacross rivers.

0x0445480.en: It flaps its short wings to flush out\pinsects from tall grass. It then plucks\pthem with its stubby beak.

0x04454EA.en: It shoots itself suddenly high into the\psky, then plummets down in one fell\pswoop to strike its prey.

0x0445551.en: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow\plarge prey whole. It can become too\pheavy to move, however.

0x04455B6.en: To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest\pwide and makes eerie sounds by expelling\pair from its mouth.

0x044561D.en: It has small electric sacs on both its\pcheeks. If threatened, it looses electric\pcharges from the sacs.

0x0445686.en: When its electricity builds, its muscles\pare stimulated, and it becomes more\paggressive than usual.

0x04456EB.en: It burrows and lives underground.\pIf threatened, it curls itself up into a\pball for protection.

0x044574C.en: It is adept at attacking with the spines\pon its back and its sharp claws while\pquickly scurrying about.

0x04457B5.en: The poison hidden in its small horn is\pextremely potent. Even a tiny scratch\pcan have fatal results.

0x044581B.en: It has a calm and caring nature.\pBecause its horn grows slowly, it\pprefers not to fight.

0x0445875.en: It uses its scaly rugged body to seal\pthe entrance of its nest and protect\pits young from predators.

0x04458DB.en: It scans its surroundings by raising\pits ears out of the grass. It will strike\pfirst if it senses any danger.

0x044594A.en: Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with\pits horn to inject a powerful poison\pwhen it becomes agitated.

0x04459B0.en: It swings its big tail around during\pbattle. If its foe flinches, it will\pcharge with its sturdy body.

0x0445A18.en: Its adorable behavior and cry make it\phighly popular. However, this cute\pPokémon is rarely found.

0x0445A7B.en: With its acute hearing, it can pick up\psounds from far away. It usually hides\pin quiet places.

0x0445ADB.en: While young, it has six gorgeous tails.\pWhen it grows, several new tails are\psprouted.

0x0445B33.en: Some legends claim that each of its\pnine tails has its own unique type of\pspecial mystic power.

0x0445B94.en: It captivates foes with its huge, round\peyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing\pa soothing melody.

0x0445BFA.en: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and\psupple. The exquisitely pleasant fur\pconveys an image of luxury.

0x0445C62.en: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on\pits ultrasonic cries for echo location to\pflit about in darkness.

0x0445CCB.en: It can drink more than 10 ounces of\pblood at once. If it has too much, it\pgets heavy and flies clumsily.

0x0445D35.en: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.”\pAt night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000\pfeet on its two roots.

0x0445DA1.en: What appears to be drool is actually\psweet honey. It is very sticky and clings\pstubbornly if touched.

0x0445E08.en: It has the world’s largest petals.\pWith every step, the petals shake out\pheavy clouds of toxic pollen.

0x0445E70.en: It is doused with mushroom spores when\pit is born. As its body grows, mushrooms\psprout from its back.

0x0445ED7.en: It stays mostly in dark, damp places.\pThe preference not of the bug, but of\pthe big mushrooms on its back.

0x0445F43.en: Its eyes also function as radar units.\pIt catches and eats small bugs that\phide in darkness.

0x0445FA1.en: The wings are covered with dustlike\pscales. Every time it flaps its wings,\pit looses highly toxic dust.

0x044600A.en: It burrows through the ground at a\pshallow depth. It leaves raised earth in\pits wake, making it easy to spot.

0x0446079.en: Its three heads bob separately up and\pdown to loosen the soil nearby, making\pit easier for it to burrow.

0x04460E3.en: It loves anything that shines.\pIt especially adores coins that it picks\pup and secretly hoards.

0x0446144.en: Many adore it for its sophisticated air.\pHowever, it will lash out and scratch\pfor little reason.

0x04461A7.en: It is constantly wracked by a headache.\pWhen the headache turns intense, it\pbegins using mysterious powers.

0x0446214.en: When it swims at full speed using its\plong, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow\pbegins to glow.

0x0446274.en: Light and agile on its feet, and\pferocious in temperament. When angered,\pit flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.

0x04462E6.en: It grows angry if you see its eyes and\pgets angrier if you run. If you beat it,\pit gets even madder.

0x044634C.en: It is extremely loyal, it will fearlessly\pbark at any opponent to protect its\pown Trainer from harm.

0x04463B2.en: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense\pof majesty. Anyone hearing it can’t help\pbut grovel before it.

0x0446417.en: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs\pare visible. It has trouble walking on\pits newly grown feet.

0x044647E.en: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly\pundulates. Staring at it gradually\pcauses drowsiness.

0x04464DC.en: It can use its well-developed arms and\plegs to run on the surface of the water\pfor a split second.

0x0446540.en: It sleeps for 18 hours a day.\pIt uses a variety of extrasensory\ppowers even while asleep.

0x044659B.en: It stares at its silver spoon to\pfocus its mind. It emits more alpha\pwaves while doing so.

0x04465F7.en: It does not like physical attacks very \pmuch. Instead, it freely uses extra-\psensory powers to defeat foes.

0x0446664.en: Though small in stature, it is powerful\penough to easily heft and throw a\pnumber of Geodude at once.

0x04466CA.en: Its formidable body never gets tired.\pIt helps people by doing work such as\pthe moving of heavy goods.

0x0446732.en: It quickly swings its four arms to rock\pits opponents with ceaseless punches\pand chops from all angles.

0x044679B.en: It plants its feet deep underground to\preplenish water. It can’t escape its\penemies while it’s rooted.

0x0446803.en: The leafy parts act as cutters for\pslashing foes. It spits a fluid that\pdissolves everything.

0x0446862.en: Acid that has dissolved many prey\pbecomes sweeter, making it even\pmore effective at attracting prey.

0x04468C8.en: It drifts aimlessly in the ocean.\pIt is very difficult to see in water,\pit may not be noticed until it stings.

0x0446938.en: It has 80 tentacles that move about\pfreely. They can sting, causing poisoning\pand sharp, stabbing pain.

0x04469A1.en: At rest, it looks just like a rock.\pCarelessly stepping on it will make it\pswing its fists angrily.

0x0446A06.en: Be careful while hiking on mountain\ptrails. Graveler may come rolling down\pthe path without slowing.

0x0446A6C.en: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as\prugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin\ponce a year to grow larger.

0x0446ADA.en: It is a weak runner immediately after\pbirth. It gradually becomes faster by\pchasing after its parents.

0x0446B42.en: At full gallop, its four hooves barely\ptouch the ground because it moves\pso incredibly fast.

0x0446BA0.en: It lazes vacantly near water.\pIf something bites its tail, it won’t\peven notice for a whole day.

0x0446C02.en: Though usually dim witted, it seems to\pbecome inspired if the Shellder on its\ptail bites down.

0x0446C62.en: It moves while constantly hovering.\pIt discharges Thunder Wave and so on\pfrom the units at its sides.

0x0446CC9.en: A linked cluster formed of several\pMagnemite. It discharges powerful\pmagnetic waves at high voltage.

0x0446D2F.en: It always walks about with a plant stalk\pclamped in its beak. The stalk is used\pfor building its nest.

0x0446D97.en: By alternately raising and lowering its\ptwo heads, it balances itself to be more\pstable while running.

0x0446DFF.en: If one of the heads gets to eat, the\pothers will be satisfied, too, and they\pwill stop squabbling.

0x0446E63.en: The colder it gets, the better it feels.\pIt joyfully swims around oceans so cold\pthat they are filled with floating ice.

0x0446EDD.en: Its streamlined body has little drag in\pwater. The colder the temperature,\pthe friskier it gets.

0x0446F3F.en: As it moves, it loses bits of its body\pfrom which new Grimer emerge. This\pworsens the stench around it.

0x0446FA8.en: Its body is made of a powerful poison.\pTouching it accidentally will cause a\pfever that requires bed rest.

0x0447014.en: It is encased in a shell that is harder\pthan diamond. Inside, however, it is\psurprisingly tender.

0x0447077.en: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot\pbe shattered, even with a bomb. The\pshell opens only when it is attacking.

0x04470EA.en: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into\pany place it desires. However, it can\pbe blown away by wind.

0x0447152.en: In total darkness, where nothing is\pvisible, Haunter lurks, silently stalking\pits next victim.

0x04471B2.en: It steals heat from its surroundings.\pIf you feel a sudden chill, it is certain\pthat a Gengar has appeared.

0x044721F.en: It twists and squirms through the ground.\pThe thunderous roar of its tunneling\pechoes a long way.

0x0447282.en: It remembers every dream it eats.\pIt rarely eats the dreams of adults\pbecause children’s are much tastier.

0x04472EE.en: Always holding a pendulum that it swings\pat a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness\pin anyone nearby.

0x0447353.en: It can be found near the sea. The large\ppincers grow back if they are torn out of\ptheir sockets.

0x04473B5.en: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown\ppincer. The pincers size makes it difficult\pto aim properly.

0x044741E.en: A life-form whose identity is unknown.\pIt is said to Screech or suddenly\pSelfdestruct.

0x0447476.en: It explodes in response to even minor\pstimuli. It is feared, with the nickname\pof “The Bomb Ball.”

0x04474DA.en: Even though it appears to be eggs of\psome sort, it was discovered to be a\plife-form more like plant seeds.

0x0447547.en: Its three heads think independently.\pHowever, they are friendly and never\pappear to squabble.

0x04475A6.en: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it\pwears shakes, and it emits a plaintive\pand mournful sound.

0x0447607.en: It collects bones from an unknown place.\pSome whisper that a Marowak graveyard\pexists somewhere in the world.

0x0447676.en: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both\plegs will stretch even longer to\pstrike a fleeing foe.

0x04476D4.en: To increase the strength of all its\ppunch moves, it spins its arms just\pbefore making contact.

0x0447734.en: Its tongue is twice the length of its\pbody. It can be moved like an arm for\pgrabbing food and attacking.

0x044779E.en: The poisonous gases it contains are\pa little bit lighter than air, keeping it\pslightly airborne.

0x0447800.en: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the\pother one deflates. It constantly mixes\pits poisonous gases.

0x0447867.en: It is inept at turning because of its\pfour short legs. It can only charge\pand run in one direction.

0x04478CC.en: Its brain developed when it began\pwalking on hind legs. Its thick hide\pprotects it even in magma.

0x044792F.en: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly\pnutritious eggs and shares them with\pinjured Pokémon or people.

0x0447992.en: The vines that cloak its entire body\pare always jiggling. They effectively\punnerve its foes.

0x04479F0.en: If it is safe, the young gets out of the\pbelly pouch to play. The adult keeps\pa close eye on the youngster.

0x0447A5D.en: It maintains balance using its tail, which\pis wound up like a coil. It may spray ink\pfrom its mouth.

0x0447AC3.en: An examination of its cells revealed the\ppresence of a gene not found in Horsea.\pIt became a hot topic.

0x0447B2C.en: During spawning season, they swim\pgracefully in the water, searching for\ptheir perfect mate.

0x0447B8A.en: The horn on its head is sharp like a\pdrill. It bores a hole in a boulder to\pmake its nest.

0x0447BE6.en: At night, the center of its body\pslowly flickers with the same rhythm\pas a human heartbeat.

0x0447C43.en: This Pokémon has a geometric body.\pBecause of its body, the locals suspect\pthat it is an alien creature.

0x0447CAD.en: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the\pability to create invisible objects as\pit matures.

0x0447D09.en: When it moves, it leaves only a blur.\pIf it hides in grass, its protective\pcoloration makes it invisible.

0x0447D74.en: It speaks a language similar to that of\phumans. However, it seems to use\pdancing to communicate.

0x0447DD6.en: It loves to feed on strong electricity.\pIt occasionally appears around large\ppower plants and so on.

0x0447E3C.en: The scorching fire exhaled by Magmar\pforms heat waves around its body, making\pit hard to see the Pokémon clearly.

0x0447EAF.en: It swings its long pincer horns wildly\pto attack. During cold periods, it hides\pdeep in forests.

0x0447F11.en: After heightening its will to fight by \pwhipping itself with its three tails,\pit charges at full speed.

0x0447F7A.en: This weak and pathetic Pokémon gets\peasily pushed along rivers when there\pare strong currents.

0x0447FDA.en: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados\pwill burn everything down, even in a\pharsh storm.

0x0448033.en: It ferries people across the sea on\pits back. It may sing an enchanting\pcry if it is in a good mood.

0x0448099.en: Its transformation ability is perfect.\pHowever, if made to laugh, it can’t\pmaintain its disguise.

0x04480FC.en: An extremely rare Pokémon that may\pevolve in a number of different ways\pdepending on stimuli.

0x044815B.en: Its cell composition is similar to water\pmolecules. As a result, it can’t be seen\pwhen it melts away into water.

0x04481CD.en: Every hair on its body starts to stand\psharply on end if it becomes charged\pwith electricity.

0x044822C.en: It fluffs out its fur collar to cool\pdown its body temperature, which can\preach 1,650 degrees.

0x04482A0.en: Using the most advanced technologies,\pscientists finally succeeded in making\pthe first artificial Pokémon.

0x044830C.en: In prehistoric times, it swam on the\psea floor, eating plankton. Its fossils\pare sometimes found.

0x044836F.en: Despite having strong fangs and\ptentacles, it went extinct when its heavy\pshell made it unable to catch prey.

0x04483DE.en: On rare occasions, some have been\pfound as fossils which they became\pwhile hiding on the ocean floor.

0x0448445.en: In the water, it tucks in its limbs to\pbecome more compact, then it wiggles\pits shell to swim fast.

0x04484AA.en: A vicious Pokémon from the distant past,\pit appears to have flown by spreading\pits wings and gliding.

0x0448511.en: When its belly is full, it becomes too\plethargic to even lift a finger, so it is\psafe to bounce on its belly.

0x0448580.en: The magnificent seemingly translucent\pwings of this legendary bird Pokémon\pare said to be made of ice.

0x04485E8.en: This legendary bird Pokémon causes\psavage thunderstorms by flapping its\pglittering wings.

0x0448643.en: This legendary Pokémon scatters\pembers with every flap of its wings.\pIt is a thrilling sight to behold.

0x04486AC.en: This Pokémon is full of life energy.\pIt continually sheds its skin and grows\psteadily larger.

0x044870B.en: They say that if it emits an aura from\pits whole body, the weather will begin\pto change instantly.

0x044876F.en: This marine Pokémon has an impressive\pbuild that lets it freely fly over raging\pseas without trouble.

0x04487D6.en: A Pokémon whose genetic code was\prepeatedly recombined for research.\pIt turned vicious as a result.

0x044883B.en: Because it can use all kinds of moves,\pmany scientists believe Mew to be the\pancestor of Pokémon.

0x044889E.en: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the\pleaf on its head. It is docile and loves\pto soak up the sun’s rays.

0x0448907.en: A spicy aroma emanates from around\pits neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant\pto restore health.

0x0448966.en: Meganium’s breath has the power to\previve dead grass and plants. It can\pmake them healthy again.

0x04489C8.en: It is timid, and always curls itself up\pin a ball. If attacked, it flares up its\pback for protection.

0x0448A2F.en: Before battle, it turns its back on\pits opponent to demonstrate how\pferociously its fire blazes.

0x0448A91.en: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot\pthat anything that touches it will\pinstantly go up in flames.

0x0448AF5.en: This rough critter chomps at any\pmoving object it sees. Turning your\pback on it is not recommended.

0x0448B5A.en: It opens its huge jaws wide when\pattacking. If it loses any fangs while\pbiting, they grow back in.

0x0448BBE.en: Although it has a massive body, its\ppowerful hind legs enable it to move\pquickly, even on the ground.

0x0448C25.en: It stands on its tail so it can see a\plong way. If it spots an enemy, it cries\ploudly to warn its kind.

0x0448C8E.en: It lives in narrow burrows that fit its\pslim body. The deeper the nests go,\pthe more maze-like they become.

0x0448CFB.en: It has a perfect sense of rhythm.\pWhatever happens, it keeps a steady\ppace by tilting its head in time.

0x0448D65.en: When it needs to think, it rotates its\phead 180 degrees to sharpen its\pintellectual power.
